description: Declared layer model for the template and minimal applications under apps/, the workspace packages and shared test support. The boundary check reads this file; the rules live here, not in the checker. See README.md#dependency-boundaries.

layers.name: test
layers.description: Unit tests may assert across layers; each imported file is still checked on its own. Cross-package tests use package names, not relative paths.

layers.name: kit-core
layers.description: Headless helpers. No React, no DOM, no app data.

layers.name: kit-react
layers.description: Controlled primitives. May use kit-core, never app layers.

layers.name: kit-elements
layers.description: Per-tag custom element registration and shared JSX typings.

layers.name: kit-styles
layers.description: Token, base and workbench shell/component CSS. No demo view selectors.

layers.name: kit-preset
layers.description: Composed preset: shell composition, generic regions, default store, commands and its element registration. Uses kit layers only, never app or demo modules.

layers.name: kit-workbench
layers.description: Public distribution facade: authored manifest/README and generated output only. Never imports implementation, app or demo modules.

layers.name: app
layers.description: Template application composition root: apps/template/src/main.tsx, apps/template/src/vscode-elements.ts and apps/template/src/app.

layers.name: demo
layers.description: Demo surfaces consumed by the template: views, commands, menus, mock data, demo components and demo CSS. Uses the preset through its public exports.

layers.name: example-minimal
layers.description: Minimal application: primitives, core, element registration and shared styles only, never the preset, template app or demo layers.

layers.name: example-custom-shell
layers.description: Custom-shell application: primitives, core, element registration and shared styles only, never the preset, template app or demo layers.
